calls.title: PepsiCo - Growth Book connect
calls.summary: The meeting covered the launch of GrowthBook's product analytics in GA version 5.0 three weeks ago, including features like behavioral tracking, A/B testing, and customer segmentation. Upcoming enhancements include a session replay feature for better insights on user behavior, expected to release within a month at no extra cost. The GrowthBook SDK offers flexible data capture options, supporting both turnkey setups and experiment-only analyses. Experiment guardrails and metrics management are now integrated with automated rollback features. The roadmap aims for further innovations by year-end, focusing on real-time experimentation and seamless integrations, particularly with Slack and Teams based on client feedback.
calls.keywords: Product Analytics, GrowthBook SDK, Session Replay, Experimentation, Guardrails, Auto Tracking

calls.title: PepsiCo - Growth Book Connect
calls.summary: The discussion revolved around enhancing product analytics and event tracking, highlighting an upcoming auto-tracking feature for SDK integration that captures user interactions with minimal effort. Event data will flow through GrowthBook's ingestion servers to managed or self-hosted warehouses like Snowflake and BigQuery. Product analytics will feature AI-driven queries, funnel visualizations indicating conversion rates, and auto-updating dashboards. Experimentation will utilize the same metrics as product analytics to ensure consistency, allowing non-technical users to set up experiments seamlessly. A new cloud-only session replay feature will capture detailed user sessions, supporting advanced insights into user behavior. The contrast between self-hosted and cloud deployments emphasized the operational simplicity of the cloud, with a quick migration process outlined. Lastly, PepsiCo will provide necessary data for cost evaluation in their cloud adoption.
calls.keywords: product analytics, event ingestion, session replay, experimentation, cloud migration, Growth Book SDK
